exposure: early skin-to-skin contact (SSC) in the delivery room
outcome: percentage of newborns receiving mother-baby skin-to-skin contact in the delivery room
cohort: The participants were newborns with prenatally diagnosed congenital heart disease (CCHD) born in regional level II-III delivery hospitals.
finding: The study successfully increased mother-baby skin-to-skin contact in the delivery room for eligible cardiac patients from a baseline of 15% to greater than 50%.
